text.title: Growth Experiment Design Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable experiment-design signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the product have at least 5,000 monthly active users AND a feature-flag platform that can randomise assignment on a stable user id?

conclusion.verdict: a controlled experiment cannot be powered or assigned; use qualitative research or ship-and-observe instead

branch.question: Is the hypothesis in the form "If we [change] for [segment], then [one metric] changes by at least [X percent] because [mechanism]"?

conclusion.verdict: rewrite the hypothesis with one metric and a numeric minimum effect before anything else

branch.question: Which design signal fails on inspection of the spec and the backlog?

conclusion.verdict: score ICE with written criteria and evidence before build
name guardrail metrics with stop thresholds

branch.when: sample_size_recorded == false OR duration_weeks < 1 OR duration_weeks > 8

conclusion.verdict: compute sample and whole-week duration; redesign if over eight weeks
assign by flag on user id with a concurrent control
run the playback; log exposure at the moment of seeing the variant
fix the stop date; record the SRM check before reading results
attach the write-up template; losers get written up too
emit the spec artefact; surface ready_for_review=true

text.example: mau=12000, flag_platform=true -> hypothesis_has_effect_size=true, primary_metric_count=1 -> ice_score_recorded=true, guardrails_with_thresholds=true, sample_size_recorded=true, duration_weeks=3, assignment_hash_key=user_id, playback_done=true, stop_date_recorded=true, srm_check_recorded=true, write_up_template_present=true -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
